title: EEP Rate-Limit Response (429)
description: Schema for HTTP 429 Too Many Requests response body returned by EEP publishers implementing DID-based token-bucket rate limiting. See SPECIFICATION.md §3.4.6 and Whitepaper §10.5. Served as `application/problem+json` per RFC 9457; the EEP-specific members below are problem extension members.

type.description: RFC 9457 problem type URI identifying what went wrong. Dereferencing it SHOULD yield human-readable documentation. Clients match on this rather than on the HTTP status, which is why it is the stable identifier.

title.description: RFC 9457 short, human-readable summary of the problem type. MUST NOT change from occurrence to occurrence — vary `detail`, not `title`.

status.description: RFC 9457 HTTP status code, repeated in the body so the problem document survives being logged or forwarded away from its response.

detail.description: RFC 9457 human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. Intended for a developer reading a log, not for an end user.

instance.description: RFC 9457 URI reference identifying this specific occurrence.

error.description: Machine-readable error code. Always 'rate_limited' for 429 responses.

did_rate_limit_key.description: The DID that was rate-limited. DID-based limiting (not IP-based) per EEP spec.

retry_after_seconds.description: Number of seconds the agent must wait before retrying. MUST match the Retry-After HTTP response header value.

window_reset_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the rate-limit window resets.

signed_challenge.description: A publisher-signed challenge token the agent MUST include as the X-EEP-RL-Challenge header on its retry request. Prevents IP-rotation evasion. Format: base64url(nonce + '.' + publisher_did + '.' + expires_at + '.' + signature).

limit_per_window.description: The total number of requests allowed per window for this DID (informational).

requests_made.description: Number of requests this DID has made in the current window (informational).

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the rate limit.
examples: DID did:web:agent.example.com has exceeded the rate limit of 100 requests per minute.
